note: Tomato Dip Recipe, tomatoes are sliced into quarters before adding to food processor
text:
4 tomatoes (take out stem and middle piece from the top)
1 tsp salt
6 cloves fresh garlic (use garlic press)
Sprinkle around Black pepper
Dash Cayenne pepper
1-2 tbsp vinegar

Put all the above in food processor with S blade

Add slowly 1/4 C Olive oil (not extra virgin) while the above is mixing with the s blade on medium to low speed
